title: Harden Core ACP/A2A header binding, TaskStore push-config eviction, and session turn cancellation cleanup
goal: Vision: V-1 Ensure production HTTP ACP routes enforce acp-session-id binding/conflict detection, reap push notification configs with evicted terminal A2A tasks, and clear evicted ACP session turn cancellations under lean ceilings and <10s warm budget

reuse.reason: Reusing existing AcpEngine header-binding methods (handle_jsonrpc_bytes_with_session_header, validate_sse_stream_bytes_with_session_header, handle_sse_stream_bytes_with_session_header_and), TaskStore reaper hookup, and AcpSessionState turn_cancellations cleanup directly with zero new dependencies.
reuse.searched: Inspected intellibitz/susi (crates/susi-core/src/acp.rs, crates/susi-gawd-a2a/src/{server.rs,task_store.rs,protocol/handler.rs,tests/server_routes.rs}, src/cli/acp_cli.rs, tests/lean_core_ceilings.rs) and intellibitz/susi-commercial-apps (crates/susi-core-client/src/acp.rs).
